articles.title: Astronomers Discover Cotton-Candy Planets That Defy Explanation
articles.summary: Two Jupiter-sized planets, TOI-791 b and c, are so fluffy they're less dense than cotton candy. Found 1,113 light-years away, they're among the rare "super-puffs" that puzzle scientists.

articles.title: DNA Computer Solves Math in a Drop of Water
articles.summary: Scientists created a DNA computer that performs calculations using billions of molecules in a tiny water droplet. It's energy-efficient and could one day run inside living cells.

articles.title: Scientist Claims He Can Cure Aging in 3 Years
articles.summary: William Andrews, a 74-year-old molecular biologist, says he's on the brink of an anti-aging pill that could make us feel 25 again. He's been chasing this dream since age 10.
